locations.note: After a dream in Indiana, the player arrives in Belém, picks a guide, Isabel or Antonio, and begins the journey up the river.
The player steers a boat along the Amazon and its tributaries, dodging logs and whirlpools, photographing wildlife and trading with locals.
The goal is to reach the hidden Inca city of Vilcabamba.

routes.name: Journey to Vilcabamba
routes.note: From Belém up the Amazon and its tributaries to the hidden Inca city of Vilcabamba.
